newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT-Acerla started as LT buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Acerla started as LT buy.

text.p: Mexican brokerage Interacciones started coverage of Acer Computec Latino America (Acerla) with a long-term buy rating, the brokerage said on Monday.

Analyst Bernardo Vera wrote in a report that Latin America is one of the fastest growing computer markets in the world. He said the joint venture between Acer Computec and the Acer Group resulted in a successful business structure.
Vera said he had a year-end price target on the stock of 32.70 pesos. The stock was down 20 centavos to 26.75 pesos in midday trade on Monday.
